newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian lending rate 10 bps down to 11.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Croatian lending rate 10 bps down to 11.4 pct.

text.p: The Croatian average lending rate edged down 10 basis points to 11.4 percent on Wednesday due to lower demand for kuna, dealers said.
The day's trade shrank to 34 million kuna from Tuesday's 117.7 million and left some three million surplus in supply.
Most fresh borrowings, totalling 31.8 million kuna, were call money at a weighted rate at 10.6 percent.
Other deals ranged from 12 percent for one-week to 14.7 for two-week and 15.6 for one-year borrowings.
Old insurers' and interbank loans were rolled over at 15 percent.

The central bank calculated its kuna midrate for Thursday weaker at 5.5899 against the dollar compared to Wednesday's 5.5573 and slightly firmer at 3.5600 against the mark from 3.5612. -- Metka Jelenc, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
